name: CARLSBAD AQUA
common_names: The Waters of the Sprudel Springs
key_symptoms: Tongue coated white. Offensive smell from mouth. Furry sensation. Sour or salty taste. Hiccough and yawning. Heartburn (Carbo).
Urine.--Stream weak and slow; only passed by pressing abdominal muscles.
Aches, with swollen temporal veins (Sang); better, motion, in open air.
